# Instellar

> Instellar is a Minecraft gens server on Minehut. Join at ragehub.minehut.gg, click Gens in the lobby, and start building your generator empire.

Server address: ragehub.minehut.gg (Minecraft Java Edition, Minehut). Also known as Instellar Gens and Instellar Minecraft.

## Pages

- [Home](https://instellar.net/): what the server is and how to join
- [Rules](https://instellar.net/rules): server rules
- [Apply](https://instellar.net/apply): staff applications
- [Punishment](https://instellar.net/punishment): punishment lookup and appeals info
